most_similar_reason: Candidate 4 shares the most distinctive cluster of episodes with the target: a hero raised among brothers who fights monsters, journeys to an otherworld/overseas realm to win the daughter of a hostile otherworld king, is killed and then magically revived by a woman, and ends by losing his sovereignty/freedom to a higher sky deity.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 3 is not a narrative at all but a descriptive account of a remote supreme creator approached through mediums, with no brothers, courtship, deaths and revivals, otherworld trials, stolen treasures, renaming, or ceding of rule.
